subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: What proof is sufficient to close this canonical issue after the open prompt-projection and provider/media fixes are resolved?
rationale: The observed failure depends on long-session model-visible payload behavior, and helper-level or UI-only coverage does not prove the reported agent-visible text loss is gone.

options.title: Require installed long-session proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent session crosses the reported context-pressure range and still shows readable tool-output text to the model.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof after merge
options.body: Close after the focused prompt-projection fix lands with green helper coverage, accepting that installed-channel proof can follow separately.

options.title: Split provider and projection work
options.body: Close only a proven aggregate-truncation subcase and keep provider/media placeholder hardening in separate linked follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Require installed long-session proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent session crosses the reported context-pressure range and still shows readable tool-output text to the model.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main session projection fix and are the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether helper-level or installed-session proof is enough.
